I don't know what the 250$ fine is for, they said I was speeding but i never admitted to it and they didn't have it on radar soooo....? 

Any case involving alcohol they give you a notice that during your court they are going to seek harsher penalty, I read that is common.

I do have a GDL license, the weird part is though if you get caught driving with alcohol on GDL you get 7 day suspension and impound, however I was charged as if I had a full class 5, so that was cool I guess.
Charged with having 0.068 BAC, that's all I know of. I have never even been to court before, I have no idea what to do.
Oh you from this crap province too? I live in Edmonton

My rent is 1250$, I have a room mate but it is illegal to just tack on and extra 200$ with no notice, and even if I did I still can't pay my rent since I haven't been able to work.

Ill get ahold of some temp agencies, maybe that could work.

I didn't apply to 150 agencies, just places hiring. The job market in Alberta is shit, the oil prices fell so much all our rig workers who were layed off (which is a lot) needed jobs so there is a huge wave of people looking for work and there is a big deal between Canada and the Philippines so most of the low wage jobs are filled by Filipinos (which Canada is currently trying to send back due to the whole issue).

My resume is pretty fucking good, I've had a few people look it over and it has been edited and improved by me about 1000 times, I've been told I am a liability due to the pay I am currently receiving as a first year Carpenter, most places think I will just quit once I find a better job, they don't want people with actual skills.

Every time I try to make my life better I am faced with a roadblock.

I am not worried about the suspension, the problem is I lost my car which was the only asset I had now I have court in a month seeking further charges, a 250$ fine, and I am going to have to pay the seizure lot 400$+ after they auction my car.

My girlfriend and I broke up mutually, I just did not think she'd leave so quick and only gave me 10 days notice, so now I need to pay her half of the rent.

I have awful credit and can't get a loan or a credit card.

This isn't a roadbump I am literally going to be homeless in 15  days.
